Added I0018 from the OECD Truth Quest Survey: 40,765 participants across 21 countries correctly identified the veracity of sampled true and false online content 60% of the time. OECD reports perceived ability was uncorrelated with measured ability, making this a useful behavioral complement to subjective trust rather than a duplicate.
